title: Assessment of Reproductive Health Disorders in Reproductive-Age Women (18–49)
description: Instrument A — Participant Questionnaire. Self-reported features for early detection of reproductive and hormonal health conditions (PCOS, endometriosis, uterine fibroids, thyroid problems and infertility). Form version RH-PARTICIPANT-v1.0.
completedHtml:
Thank you.

Your answers have been recorded under your study code. Information will be used only for research and reported in aggregate.

elements.name: consent_info
elements.html: You are invited to take part in a study on the early detection of reproductive and hormonal health conditions such as PCOS, endometriosis, uterine fibroids, thyroid problems and infertility. We will ask about your menstrual history, symptoms, past pregnancies, infections, family history, lifestyle and your views on digital health tools. Some questions are personal; you may skip any question or stop at any time without consequence. No name, phone number, national ID, e-mail or date of birth is recorded; your answers are stored under a study code. Your answers may be linked to a clinical assessment by a health worker only if you give separate consent for that. Information will be used only for research and reported in aggregate.
